# Mutually-exclusive compile modes

Exactly one of --full or --pr must be provided to the compile command; supplying both or neither raises a UsageError.

Ensure the compile command runs in a single, well-defined mode (either a full compile or an incremental PR compile) to avoid ambiguous behavior.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/cli.py` — `knowledge_compiler.cli.compile_cmd`
